infos.urlText: Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield
infos.content:
Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November
  • Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between:
    - Leppington and Central, platforms 1-14 via Sydenham
    - Fairfield and Central, platforms 1-14
    - Homebush and North Sydney
  • Buses also replace T3 Liverpool & Inner West Line trains between Liverpool and Lidcombe via Regents Park.

  • From 9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday, buses replace trains between Leppington and East Hills.
  • Trains run between East Hills and the City, to a changed timetable.
Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run around the City Circle but continue to run between Central and Wynyard.
  • For travel to Circular Quay, St James or Museum use light rail, local buses or walk.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
11T8   Campbelltown, Minto, Ingleburn, Glenfield and return
79T2   Macarthur, all stations to Fairfield and return
80T2   Liverpool, all stations to Fairfield and return
 
9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday
22T2   Leppington, all stations to East Hills and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
infos.subtitle: Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield

infos.urlText: City Circle: Trains do not run to Circular Quay, St James or Museum
infos.content:
Friday 6 to Sunday 8 November
 
  • From 10.40pm Friday, trains do not run around the City Circle but continue to run between Central, Town Hall and Wynyard, continuing to T1 North Shore Line stations.
  • For travel to Circular Quay, St James or Museum use light rail, local buses or walk.

  • Trackwork also affects trains on other lines.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
infos.subtitle: City Circle: Trains do not run to Circular Quay, St James or Museum

infos.content:
From Sunday to Thursday, between 10pm and 5am, ceiling installation works will take place in the pedestrian tunnel between platforms 4 and 11 and the lower concourse.
 - During this time, the Redfern end stairs on Platforms 4 to 11 will be closed.
 - Customer will need to use the City end of the platform to exit via the Grand Concourse.
 - If you need assistance, ask station staff or call 9379 1777.
infos.subtitle: Station Update - Central

infos.content:
Access Restriction 
Central Station - Entry & Exit to Chalmers Street near the Dental Hospital Is closed until further notice.
infos.subtitle: Station Update - Central

infos.content:
From Monday 26 October until Tuesday 8 December, ramp resurfacing works will be taking place at Strathfield Station. During this time, the pedestrian ramp to access Platforms 1 and 2 (Homebush end) will be closed for upgrades.
Please use the other pedestrian ramp (Burwood end) or the lift (middle of the platform) to access or exit the platform.

If you need assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9752 8430.
infos.subtitle: Station Update - Strathfield
